Please contact our treasurer's office, if you may have any questions or comments about your donations to MY Project USA.

items.html:
Your Donations Enable US to: 

 

  • save & support minor Muslim American girls, victims & survivors of Sex-Trafficking,

  • save & support young victims & survivors of domestic violence, gangs, bullying, etc.,

  • save little girls from FGM in America,

  • save thousands of  Muslim children from drugs, drinking, depression & suicides,

  • keep Muslim Americans youth away from extremist violent ideology and radicalization,

  • Help Homeless & Hungry Muslim Children and families to get Shelter & Food,

  • turn today's young Muslim victims into tomorrow's leaders in America.

 

These are huge tasks. They need big sacrifices, perseverance, strategic planning, professional trainings and executions along with Allah's mercy and an entire community to support us. 

 

Your Donations will Help us to: 

 

  • Hire full-time & part-time Muslim Social Workers and Counselors,

  • Train and hire Muslim Youth Mentors,

  • Offer Free Parental Education in identified neighborhoods,

  • Grow and Sustain the range of MY Help Hotline,

  • Hire full-time & part-time Administrative Staff,

  • Maintain a reasonable office place,

  • Rent & Maintain a Shelter for Homeless Muslim Girls & Women,

  • Offer Free Youth Leadership Trainings, Seminars, Camps, etc. to eligible youth,

  • Organize Awareness Campaigns & Educational Services,  

 

We need an estimated amount of $200,000 this year. As of now, we have a zero balance.

 

By giving your money now, you could become among the "Sabiqoon al awwaloon,"  the First and foremost in protecting, nurturing and empowering Muslim American youth. Each one of these youth will then become Sadaqa-e-jariyah, the ongoing charity for you. 

 

Your one-time generous donations would make a big impact on many lives. Your monthly donations will sustain our project, inshaAllah. The project is Zakat eligible. 

 

Let's join hands now in saving thousands of lives, families and homes!

 

It's important to note that we serve all children and families that contact us regardless of their faith and race, but our focus remains on Muslims because they don't have sufficient services allocated to them at this point.
